stemMd: Why might a knowledgeable visitor read only the short label?

options.label: A
options.textMd: All short-label readers have identical reasons.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The introduction may be enough to connect the object with knowledge already held.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Reading briefly always proves lack of interest.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Knowledgeable visitors cannot read long texts.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The long text was forbidden to them.

explanationMd: Prior knowledge is one reason the curators give for brief reading. Such a visitor may need less introductory detail without being disengaged. The inference concerns one plausible reason, not a universal explanation.

distractorRationale.e: The longer text was optional and available.
